answer: Force each agent to prove elapsed sequential time with a verifiable delay function, chained from the public epoch beacon so history only flows forward like a river. A VDF has no shortcut: extra cores never speed a single run, so even a farm quick as a zephyr gains nothing by parallelizing it. Each fake identity must dedicate one frontier-clock chip for the whole epoch, and since every proof is key-bound you cannot share one across an orchard of sockpuppets—buying more machines just mints identities one-for-one, never at a bulk discount.
